title.text: The Kitten and the Vine Bridge

s1.text: In a warm green forest, between two tall trees, there was a vine bridge. It swayed gently above a singing stream. On one side lived Pilou, a little striped kitten. On the other side lived his friend Bako, a little monkey with big ears. Every day, Bako hopped across the bridge to come and play.

s2.text: One evening, Bako arrived full of joy. “Pilou! Tonight, at my place, the moonflowers are going to open. They glow like lamps! Come and see them with me!” Pilou looked at the bridge. It moved, it creaked, it swayed. His heart started to beat very fast. “I… I have never crossed it,” he whispered. His little ears folded back.

s3.text: Bako sat down beside him. “You’re scared, and that’s okay. I know this bridge by heart. I know where it’s strong.” He held out his long tail. “Hold on to me. Put your paws where I put mine. I won’t let go of you.” Pilou looked at his friend. Bako had never laughed at him. Not even once.

s4.text: So Pilou took hold of Bako’s tail. One step. The bridge swayed. “I’m here,” said Bako. Two steps. The stream babbled below. “Breathe with me.” Three steps, four steps. Pilou wasn’t looking down anymore. He was looking at his friend’s back, in front of him. And little by little, his paws trembled less.

s5.text: “We made it!” said Bako. Pilou opened his eyes wide. He had crossed the whole bridge! Just then, the moonflowers opened, one by one, all white and glowing. “It’s beautiful,” breathed Pilou. “Thank you, Bako. On my own, I wouldn’t have dared.” Bako smiled. “You trusted me. And you were brave.”

s6.text: The two friends settled into a hammock of leaves, near the glowing flowers. The bridge swayed very gently, like a cradle. Bako yawned. Pilou purred. The stream hummed its evening song, always the same, always so soft. And soon, the little kitten and the little monkey were asleep. You too, let yourself be rocked, very gently.

outro.text: When you have a friend you can count on, big steps become easier. Good night, little one. Sweet dreams.
